Header: Colletotrichum gloeosporioides In Sinhala: Anthracnose, Dagara Rogaya; In Tamil: Kuulan Nooj

Prevention: Crop rotation with pulses, grains and crucifers
Timely planting, Maha season – Mid to
Proper land preparation to improve drainage system
Seed, seedling & bulb treatment (For bulb crop-treat seeds with recommended fungicide / dip seedling in fungicide solution, for seed crop-immerse bulbs 30 minutes before planting in fungicide)
Trichoderma as seed treatment and use of
Wash off dew by spraying water in the morning
Prevent the entry of water from infected fields to healthy fields
Covering the seed crops using polythene
Monitoring: Regular field visits –Close monitoring has to be done during wet weather, on leaves.
Monitoring to detect development of symptoms on leaves & bulbs:
Twisted leaves; Oval-shaped whitish sunken spots; Black patches (fungal fruiting structures)
Restrictions: Apply fungicides just after appearance of symptom
For seed crop calendar based application should be followed
To avoid the development of resistance, a maximum of 2 applications per chemical per season
U (Unlikely to present acute hazard in normal use); Thiophanate
